name: Vicarious
source:
A VN which is currently being worked on by two people. The main cast is just the main charecter and the player, both go through this together to figure out themselves. Has 1 confirmed fight which is quick time event based (which is pretty unusual for a visual novel). The story is planned to be on the shorter side so much can't be said.
The Instagram account of the VN: https://www.instagram.com/vicarious_game/
The YouTube account of the VN: https://www.youtube.com/@Vicarious_Game
